methodology.name: EGX_PRO_FUNDAMENTAL_MULTI_PILLAR_1.0
principles: No financial metric is invented or inferred when the source does not provide it.
Secondary standardized data is clearly separated from official audited disclosures.
Banks, insurers and financial services use a different balance-sheet treatment.
Fair value is relative peer valuation, not a DCF or guaranteed intrinsic value.
Insufficient or stale data produces DATA_INSUFFICIENT instead of a score.
